name: dsh-wsl-workspace
description: WSL workspace support for DeepSeek Harness: add a WSL workspace from the web GUI and run the whole agent session (bash + file tools) inside the WSL distribution, VS Code Remote-WSL style. No toolchain install inside WSL required. Works on DSH Desktop as well as dsh web.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsdown && node scripts/verify-lib.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/variants.test.ts tests/paths.test.ts tests/references.test.ts tests/locales.test.ts tests/readme-compat.test.mjs tests/wsl-output-decode.test.ts tests/default-distro-parity.test.ts tests/deliberate-reds.test.mjs tests/client-classnames.test.ts tests/support/fake-child-process.test.mjs tests/wsl-env.test.ts tests/wsl-bash-protocol.test.ts tests/wsl-bash-starve.test.ts tests/wsl-bash-tty.test.ts tests/pty-readiness.test.mjs scripts/check-portable-spelling.test.mjs tests/tool-contract.test.mjs tests/client-wiring.test.mjs tests/parity-claims.test.mjs tests/docs-debt.test.mjs && node scripts/check-unit-closure.mjs
scripts.test:node: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/shell.test.ts tests/fs-execution-context.test.ts tests/wsl-jobs.test.ts tests/wsl-search.test.ts tests/wsl-bash-parity.test.ts tests/wsl-terminal-tool.test.ts tests/client-lifecycle.test.mjs && node tests/host-materialize.mjs && node tests/host-materialize.mjs --pty && node tests/host-declare.mjs && node tests/host-declare.mjs --pty && node tests/persistent-shell-fallback.mjs && node tests/shell-execute-shape.mjs && node scripts/typecheck-gate.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-rank-parity.mjs --strict && node scripts/check-host-prompt-parity.mjs
scripts.test:node:fresh: npm run build && npm run test:node
scripts.test:wsl: node --experimental-strip-types tests/smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/exec-shape.mjs && node tests/shell-extra.mjs && node scripts/make-smoke-built.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/smoke-built.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/run-wsl-real.mjs --plane src --drivers fs-real,skills-real,search-real,relay-real,relay-profile-real,distro-shape-real,tool-bash-real,bash-session-real,bash-parity-real
